name: SourceMint
description: SourceMint (SRCMNT) is a fixed-supply, open-source ERC-20 on Base with no ICO and no token sale. Supply enters circulation as rewards for merged contributions to its public Foundry repository, under a published reward policy. Every transfer out of a project wallet is recorded in a public ledger with its reason, and continuous integration re-verifies that ledger against the chain. The contract has no owner or admin functions and no further minting is possible; it supports burning and ERC-2612 permit.
